name: When should I consider full siding replacement instead of just repairs?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider full siding replacement instead of just repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider full siding replacement when damage is extensive, widespread, or recurring, indicating systemic issues rather than isolated incidents. If more than 20-30% of your fiber cement siding panels are damaged, or if there are signs of significant moisture penetration, rot, or structural problems beneath the siding, a full replacement might be more cost-effective in the long run. Also, if your siding is very old and frequently requires repairs, a replacement could offer better long-term value and improved home aesthetics.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider full replacement when damage is extensive, widespread, recurring, or involves significant underlying structural issues, or if repairs become too frequent.
